question_record.context: As part of investigating a multi-stage security incident involving potentially compromised assets exhibiting ransomware-like behavior on the host `vnevado-win11t`, a suspicious remote activity was observed. This activity is commonly flagged for initiating interactive sessions, modifying files, or other potentially malicious actions remotely. An automated remediation action might be taken to disable the account or device used by the attacker.
question_record.question: Can you determine the hostname of the endpoint where ransomware behavior was detected in the file system?
solution: The user account with AadUserId `731adb71-b11c-4bbf-850b-57989b350e96` is potentially compromised and exhibiting ransomware-like behavior.
Suspicious remote activity was observed on host `vnevado-win11u`.
Ransomware behavior detected in the file system of host `vnevado-win11u` indicates potential mass encryption of files by ransomware.

157.name: Potentially compromised assets exhibiting ransomware-like behavior
157.description: Potentially compromised assets are exhibiting ransomware-like behavior, impacting several devices. An attacker may be operating using the specified user account, IP, or device to move laterally across the network and infect as many devices as possible with ransomware. Automated remediation action might be taken to disable the account or device the attacker used.

88.name: Suspicious remote activity
88.description: Suspicious activity initiated remotely was observed on this machine. This alert can flag attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, and other potentially malicious activities from a remote machine.

160.name: Ransomware behavior detected in the file system
160.description:
Suspicious file system changes might indicate ransomware activity. This potential ransomware activity might be indicative of mass encryption of files by ransomware.

For more information, read the Ransomware: A pervasive and ongoing threat Threat Analytics report: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/05658b6c-dc62-496d-ad3c-c6a795a33c27/analystreport

Also read the Activity Profile: Iranian MOIS operators opportunistically deploy limited-impact wiper in response to Israel-Hamas war Threat Analytics report: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/c6674205-df28-453a-9e42-0010b7979bdd/overview?tid4b2462a4-bbee-495a-a0e1-f23ae524cc9c

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Device_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: Potentially compromised assets exhibiting ransomware-like behavior
